HHCT-M1.description: Heat of Hydration Analysis Control Data (HHCT-M1). A single-instance record; FINAL_STAGE selects the target construction stage, OPT_IS_CREEP_SHRINKAGE/ITEM drive the creep-shrinkage settings, and CONVERGENCE holds the per-criterion tolerance items.

FINAL_STAGE.description: Analyze at the final (last) construction stage. When true, STAGE_NAME is ignored; when false, STAGE_NAME must be given and must reference an existing construction stage.

STAGE_NAME.description: Target construction stage name. Required and must match an existing stage when FINAL_STAGE is false; ignored when FINAL_STAGE is true.

EVAL.description: Element stress evaluation location: CENTER, GAUSS, or NODAL. Case-insensitive.

OPT_USE_EQUI_AGE.description: Use equivalent age accounting for time and temperature.

OPT_INCL_SELF_WEIGHT.description: Include self-weight load. When false, SELF_WEIGHT_FACTOR is ignored.

SELF_WEIGHT_FACTOR.description: Self-weight scale factor. Applied only when OPT_INCL_SELF_WEIGHT is true.

OPT_IS_CREEP_SHRINKAGE.description: Consider creep and shrinkage effects. When true, ITEM must be supplied; when false, ITEM is ignored.

ITEM.description: Creep & shrinkage settings. Required when OPT_IS_CREEP_SHRINKAGE is true.

TYPE.description: Which time-dependent effects to consider: CREEP only, SHRINKAGE only, or BOTH. Case-insensitive.

CREEP_CALC_METHOD.description: Creep calculation method: 0 = General, 1 = Effective Modulus. When 1, M_EFF_MOD must be supplied.

M_EFF_MOD.description: Effective-modulus parameters. Required when CREEP_CALC_METHOD is 1.

PHI1.description: Creep coefficient phi at the first age point.

PHI2.description: Creep coefficient phi at the second age point.

ITER.description: Maximum number of iterations per increment.

CONVERGENCE.description: Convergence criteria. Each of DISP, LOAD, WORK is an item with an on/off flag and tolerance; if CONVERGENCE is omitted, the solver defaults to LOAD and WORK enabled at 0.001 and 1e-6.

OPT_CHECK.description: Enable the displacement convergence check. When false, VALUE is ignored.

VALUE.description: Displacement convergence tolerance. Used when OPT_CHECK is true (defaults to 0.001).

OPT_CHECK.description: Enable the load convergence check. When false, VALUE is ignored.

VALUE.description: Load convergence tolerance. Used when OPT_CHECK is true (defaults to 0.001).

OPT_CHECK.description: Enable the work convergence check. When false, VALUE is ignored.

VALUE.description: Work convergence tolerance. Used when OPT_CHECK is true (defaults to 1e-6).
